entities.text: HIGH COURT OF GUJARAT AT AHMEDABAD
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard learned Advocate Mr. Naman K. Brahmbhatt on behalf of the petitioner and learned Assistant Government Pleader Mr. Aditya Pathak on behalf of the respondent-State.

2. By way of this petition, a very limited direction is sought for inasmuch as an appeal preferred by the present petitioner to the State Government i.e. to the Additional Chief Secretary, Panchayat and Rural Housing Department, which is pending consideration of the concerned authority since last one year and whereas the request being to direct the authority to decide the same within some short stipulated period of time.
3. Learned AGP Mr. Pathak would submit under instructions that the concerned authority is awaiting report from the Forensic Science Laboratory with regard to the issue in question and whereas till such report is received, the authority may not be directed to decide the appeal.

In the considered C/SCA/10347/2022 ORDER DATED: 17/02/2023 opinion of this Court, the submission Rashikbhai Vinubhai Dabhi vs State Of Gujarat on 17 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/25609115/
1 made by learned AGP under instructions appears to be completely misplaced.

entities.text: Rashikbhai Vinubhai Dabhi vs State Of Gujarat on 17 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The authority concerned is not deciding upon the legality and validity of the allegation against the present petitioner more particularly with regard to the FIR filed against him for offences punishable under Sections 498A and 306 of the Indian Penal Code.

To this Court it appears clearly that the authority concerned is looking into an appeal whereby the appeal of the petitioner against an order dated 08.09.2021 terminating the services of the petitioner more particularly without holding a departmental inquiry is under challenge.

4. In this view of the matter, to this Court it does not appear that there would be any relevance or requirement for the concerned authority to wait till a report of Forensic Science Laboratory more particularly since it appears that a full-fledged departmental inquiry has not been initiated against the present petitioner.

5. Under such circumstances, the Additional Chief Secretary, Panchayat and Rural Housing Department is directed to decide the appeal preferred by the petitioner on 21.09.2021 as expeditiously as possible and in any case before 01.05.2023 without fail.
6. With this limited direction present petition stands disposed of.
Civil Application also consequently stands disposed of.

(NIKHIL S. KARIEL,J) NIRU Rashikbhai Vinubhai Dabhi vs State Of Gujarat on 17 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/25609115/
